window_selection: 32 integer-linspace input ends from 34560 through 46076 inclusive; zero-based end-exclusive; no targets read
order: Rotate engine/output-mode combinations by trial+seed_index+workload_index; fresh serial process per cell
timing: Monotonic ns; all mode returns 96 values per window, last mode one; resident prepared inputs; no clock subtraction; consume checksum outside timing
statistics: nearest-rank p50/p95/p99, mean, min/max; per-trial reports and ranges, no IID confidence claim
memory: process peak RSS after imports, setup and timing; high-water marks, not live allocation or attributable model memory; native owned bytes separately
limitations: Warm resident inputs; uncontrolled OS scheduling/frequency/cache
Torch standard uses FP32 layer_norm, exact GELU and SDPA; last query reads all K/V rows without a causal mask; strict FP64 reference only prepares expected outputs
CPU compatibility benchmark on available host, not current-runtime frontier
No compiled Torch, ONNX, quantization, profiling, sustained/concurrent streams or network costs
First call follows model loading; no cold-disk/cache or full process startup claim
purpose: Report within-engine removal of unused diagnostic outputs separately from matched latest-only latency. Current one-block architecture; no weight/objective change.
numerical_gate: Native latest-prefix outputs bitwise equal preserved full traces on all 9216 saved-window origins; matched engines retain 5e-5 absolute/2e-4 relative tolerance; all outputs checked before each cell
performance_gate: Native latest must reduce median paired batch-one p50 by at least 50% versus its full trace, improve each seed in median and not worsen median paired p99. Report all cells. Matched latest-only engine ratios are separate; the current-runtime frontier target is not established by this compatibility run.
